name: Traditional Herbal Face & Skin Care Powder
shortDescription: A natural everyday bath powder for glowing, healthy skin, inspired by traditional beauty rituals.
description: Crafted from a blend of wild turmeric, green gram, and aromatic herbs, our Herbal Face & Skin Care Powder acts as a gentle exfoliant and natural cleanser. Regular use helps maintain an even skin tone, reduces blemishes, and leaves the skin feeling fresh and radiant.
howToUse: Mix required amount with water or rose water to make a smooth paste.
Apply evenly over face and body.
Gently scrub and wash off with normal water.
storageInstructions: Keep tightly sealed in a dry place to prevent moisture absorption.
